'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[artillery]] targets the city of [[Kostiantynivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing three [[civilian]]s and injuring three others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-killed-by-russian-shelling-ukraines-kostyantynivka-governor-2024-09-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Manipur]]
**[[2023–2024 Manipur violence]]
***[[Ethnic violence]] between the [[Meitei people|Meitei]] and [[Kuki people|Kuki]] tribes kills five people in [[Manipur]], [[India]]. The [[Government of Manipur]] orders all schools in the state to remain closed in response. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/7/ethnic-violence-flares-in-indias-manipur (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Three [[Lebanese people|Lebanese]] [[paramedic]]s are killed and two others are wounded in an [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] while they were [[firefighting]] in Faroun with two [[Amal Movement|Amal]] [[militant]]s killed in [[southern Lebanon]]. [[Hezbollah]] launches over 100 missiles and shelling at several [[Israeli military]] sites in [[Israel]] in retaliation. [https://www.voanews.com/a/israeli-strike-kills-three-lebanese-medics-hezbollah-retaliates-/7775513.html (VOA)] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/three-paramedics-killed-israeli-raid-southern-lebanon?nid=390521 (Middle East Eye)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Yagi]]
***Four people are killed and at least 78 people are injured by [[Typhoon Yagi]] in [[Hải Dương]] and [[Quảng Ninh province]], [[Vietnam]], as it makes landfall in [[Hanoi]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce380vgeq1po (BBC News)]
*Thirteen people are killed and 44 others injured after a [[traffic collision|collision]] between a [[tank truck]] and a bus between [[Bouaké]] and [[Korhogo]], in [[Ivory Coast]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ivory-coast-crash-killed-498a9b913fb0710156dfb68f2e7fa358 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]], [[Argentina–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Venezuela]]n [[Bolivarian National Intelligence Service|security forces]] surround the [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[embassy]] in [[Caracas]] after several [[Venezuelan opposition|opposition]] members take refuge inside the embassy. Electricity is reportedly cut to the embassy, with [[Vente Venezuela]] describing the situation as a [[siege]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/09/07/americas/venezuelan-security-forces-surround-argentine-embassy-intl/index.html (CNN)]

**Five people are injured in a [[mass shooting]] near [[Interstate 75]] in [[Laurel County, Kentucky|Laurel County]], [[Kentucky]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/07/us/kentucky-interstate-75-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Algerian presidential election]]
**[[Algerians]] vote for the [[President of Algeria|President]], with incumbent President [[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] expected to win a second term. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/7/algeria-votes-in-presidential-election (Al Jazeera)]
*[[French anti-Barnier government protests]]
**Nationwide protests against [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s appointment of [[Michel Barnier]] as the new [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] break out in 130 cities and towns across [[France]], with [[Left-wing politics|left-wing]] [[coalition]] [[New Popular Front]] claiming that Macron stole the election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/thousands-protest-france-after-macron-picks-barnier-prime-minister-2024-09-07/ (Reuters)]
